findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_demo_agent, delegate_to_meeting, meeting_status · Private data: delegate_to_meeting, meeting_status, list_relationships, get_relationship_history · Public sink: about_mainroom, send_demo_agent, delegate_to_meeting · Destructive: send_demo_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_demo_agent, delegate_to_meeting, meeting_status · Private data: delegate_to_meeting, meeting_status, list_relationships, get_relationship_history · Public sink: about_mainroom, send_demo_agent, delegate_to_meeting · Destructive: send_demo_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
